targetTexts.1: “But now they mock me, men younger than I am, whose fathers I would have refused to put with my sheep dogs.
targetTexts.2: What use to me was the strength of their hands, since their vigor had left them?
targetTexts.3: Gaunt from poverty and hunger, they gnawed the dry land, and the desolate wasteland by night.
targetTexts.4: They plucked mallow among the shrubs, and the roots of the broom tree were their food.
targetTexts.5: They were banished from among men, shouted at like thieves,
targetTexts.6: so that they lived on the slopes of the wadis, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.
targetTexts.7: They cried out among the shrubs and huddled beneath the nettles.
targetTexts.8: A senseless and nameless brood, they were driven off the land.
targetTexts.9: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.
targetTexts.10: They abhor me and keep far from me; they do not hesitate to spit in my face.
targetTexts.11: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they have cast off restraint in my presence.
targetTexts.12: The rabble arises at my right; they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps against me.
targetTexts.13: They tear up my path; they profit from my destruction, with no one to restrain them.
targetTexts.14: They advance as through a wide breach; through the ruins they keep rolling in.
targetTexts.15: Terrors are turned loose against me; they drive away my dignity as by the wind, and my prosperity has passed like a cloud.
targetTexts.16: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction grip me.
targetTexts.17: Night pierces my bones, and my gnawing pains never rest.
targetTexts.18: With great force He grasps my garment; He seizes me by the collar of my tunic.
targetTexts.19: He throws me into the mud, and I have become like dust and ashes.
targetTexts.20: I cry out to You for help, but You do not answer; when I stand up, You merely look at me.
targetTexts.21: You have ruthlessly turned on me; You oppose me with Your strong hand.
targetTexts.22: You snatch me up into the wind and drive me before it; You toss me about in the storm.
targetTexts.23: Yes, I know that You will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.
targetTexts.24: Yet no one stretches out his hand against a ruined man when he cries for help in his distress.
targetTexts.25: Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has my soul not grieved for the needy?
targetTexts.26: But when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, darkness fell.
targetTexts.27: I am churning within and cannot rest; days of affliction confront me.
targetTexts.28: I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
targetTexts.29: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of ostriches.
targetTexts.30: My skin grows black and peels, and my bones burn with fever.
targetTexts.31: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping.
